subject.title: DuckDuckGo (requiresCredential=false) is never auto-selected as web_search provider even when enabled

question: Should OpenClaw reverse the shipped explicit opt-in policy and allow managed `web_search` to implicitly select key-free providers such as DuckDuckGo when no credentialed provider is configured?
rationale: Current main, docs, tests, and merged policy require explicit selection for key-free managed search providers, so the requested behavior is a provider-routing and outbound data-sharing product decision rather than a strict bug fix.

options.title: Keep explicit opt-in
options.body: Reject implicit keyless fallback and address the remaining user confusion through diagnostics, setup guidance, or docs for selecting DuckDuckGo explicitly.

options.title: Approve full reversal
options.body: Allow implicit keyless fallback only with aligned runtime metadata, setup behavior, docs, compatibility tests, and real behavior proof.

options.title: Pause the candidate PR
options.body: Leave the issue and PR in maintainer review until the provider-routing policy owner decides whether this behavior should exist.

recommendation.title: Keep explicit opt-in
recommendation.body: Reject implicit keyless fallback and address the remaining user confusion through diagnostics, setup guidance, or docs for selecting DuckDuckGo explicitly.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the merged explicit opt-in policy that this issue and the open PR would reverse.
